ideas.pitch: A browser extension that acts as a trust and misinformation scanner for local community blogs and student journalism.
ideas.problem_statement: Truth in the Digital Age: Develop solutions addressing misinformation, digital literacy, online trust, and responsible information sharing.
ideas.title: VeritasFeed
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses information integrity directly with a working extension rather than a conceptual platform, appealing strongly to judges looking for tangible digital literacy tools.

ideas.pitch: An interactive digital platform that visualizes local municipal budgets and allows youth to co-propose community improvements.
ideas.problem_statement: Democracy, Dialogue & Diplomacy: Build tools that encourage constructive dialogue, civic participation, collaboration, and peaceful problem-solving.
ideas.title: CivicCanvas
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven civic-tech hackathon win pattern by providing a live dashboard and immediate community utility.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web archive that preserves endangered regional dialects and folklore through community-submitted audio and AI translation.
ideas.problem_statement: Digital Creativity & Culture: Use technology to preserve culture, empower creative expression, and make digital experiences more meaningful.
ideas.title: FolkloreLingua
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets cultural preservation with an emotionally resonant demo that connects strongly with writing- and arts-focused hackathon organizers.

ideas.pitch: A customizable web reader that transforms complex public policy documents into dyslexia-friendly, simplified formats with read-aloud functionality.
ideas.problem_statement: Opportunity Without Barriers: Create inclusive digital solutions that improve accessibility and expand opportunities for underserved communities.
ideas.title: AccessRead
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven accessibility hackathon winning strategy of solving a friction point that judges experience firsthand when reading dense text.

ideas.pitch: A moderated peer-to-peer dialogue app that structures online arguments with AI-assisted premise mapping to encourage constructive consensus.
ideas.problem_statement: Democracy, Dialogue & Diplomacy: Build tools that encourage constructive dialogue, civic participation, collaboration, and peaceful problem-solving.
ideas.title: VerseDebate
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on constructive online discourse, aligning with the core mission of Writers' Haven and the dialogue track.
